create_feedtensor_instance: create a FeedTensor instance with a name and shape to prepare a tensor buffer for incremental feeding
feed_values_to_tensor: feed values into a FeedTensor buffer incrementally using the Feed method with flattened data
feed_vector3_with_mask: feed 3D vector values into a FeedTensor with optional x, y, z axis masking via FeedVector3
verify_tensor_capacity: verify whether a FeedTensor can accept additional values without exceeding its allocated dimension count
get_tensor_device: retrieve the final PyTorch tensor from a FeedTensor and move it to the appropriate device via GetTensor
